wheel.build: PEP 517 setuptools --no-isolation from a copy outside the clone; SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH from the implementation commit, identical digest observed on repeated builds

summary: Bulk POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE now use the real InfLabs 0.3.0a1 consumer contract: scoped whole-batch POST admission inside the view queryset with per-object permissions before writes, duplicate/ambiguous identity and new-slug rules, explicit default-deny collection DELETE (no cascade via a parent, no delete-restriction target, data-mart can_delete for entities), one write alias. Validators use requires_context/__call__(attrs, serializer); the global-manager upsert is gone. filterset_class is wired for filters and the legacy filter_class path is explicit and tested; filters change the selection and preserve queryset/permission constraints. A separate real-runtime gate builds and installs the wheel offline, compares 371 installed sources and 378 RECORD entries, and runs the 45-test runtime suite (routers, bulk CRUD/permissions/rollback, filters, BitField/RecursiveField, one root Entity) plus migrations drift.
unverified: Optional auth/admin/search/task/geo extra groups are declared but not installed or verified for the pilot.
No live database, deployment, restart, release or push was performed; tests use synthetic SQLite only.
Single write alias and single-database transactions only; distributed atomicity is not claimed or tested.
The djangorestframework-filters 1.0.0.dev2 + django-filter 26.2 pin is the accepted research matrix, not a maintained-support proof.
Independent E8.runtimecheck acceptance is still pending.
